simple.meaning: אֶלֶף (ʼeleph) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a family ; also (from the sense of yoking or taming) an ox or cow.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 8 times across Deuteronomy, Judges, Psalms, Proverbs, Isaiah, beginning at Deuteronomy 7:13. Its contexts include family, flock, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֶלֶף (H504).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: אֶלֶף (ʼeleph) / H504 is traced through Deuteronomy 7:13, Deuteronomy 28:4, Deuteronomy 28:18, Deuteronomy 28:51 as a generated source-based concept entry.

structuredEvidence.definition: a family ; also (from the sense of yoking or taming) an ox or cow

firstOccurrence.englishText: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.

timeline.evidenceText: He will love you, bless you, and multiply you. He will also bless the fruit of your body and the fruit of your ground, your grain and your new wine and your oil, the increase of your livestock and the young of your flock, in the land which he swore to your fathers to give you.
You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.
The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.

They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.
He said to him, “O Lord,* The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.” how shall I save Israel? Behold, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father’s house.”
the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea,
Where no oxen are, the crib is clean,
The oxen likewise and the young donkeys that till the ground will eat savory feed, which has been winnowed with the shovel and with the fork.

definitions.full: H504. eleph I. [ אלֶף ֶ֫ ] noun masculine Psa 8:8 ; only plural cattle (Phoenician אלף , Assyrian alpu , COT Gloss ) — אֲלָפִים Prov 14:4 ; Isa 30:24 used in tillage; subject to man Psa 8:8 (|| צֹנֶה ); their increase אֲלָפֶיךָ שְׁגַר a blessing Deut 7:13 ; 28:4 , 18 , 51 (|| all צאֹנֶ֑ךָ עַשְׁתִּרֹת ).
